_comment: Size caps a pack is measured against by `qwbe check` (core/src/package-size.ts), ported from software-factory (ADR-0006: splitting is driven by size, measured in characters). A unit is one cube directory. Ships in the kernel tarball, which is why it is not in the root qwbe.yaml.
_countModeComment: 'code' measures characters with comments stripped; 'raw' measures every byte. This repository keeps the reasoning next to the rule, so several files are more comment than code - capping raw would make deleting an explanation the cheapest way to go green. Both numbers are printed either way; only this one is enforced.
_capsComment: Owner approval 2026-09-05 (QWB-63, in the PR body): maxCharsPerFile 6000 -> 50000 and maxCharsPerUnit 40000 -> 50000, raised without a split by explicit owner decision; no further raise is authorized. The kernel size gate and its baseline were dropped in stage 5 (docs/plan/stage-1-map.md); these caps stay for packs until stage 6.
